title.narrative: BRAVE: Building Respect and Anti-Violence Education for Women and Girls in Sierra Leone's Schools

description.narrative: A total of 10,000 women and men will be registered as direct participants in tertiary educational institutions. Men are crucial as a direct target group (here mainly as allies and also as pioneers in awareness-raising efforts, peer-to-peer education) in initiatives against SGBV, as although SGBV predominantly affects women, the direct involvement of men promotes a more comprehensive approach to solving the problem. The project aims to reach 20% men (2,000) out of the target group of 10,000 people.

Impact: Students in Sierra Leone's tertiary education system are better protected from sexual and gender-based violence and can learn and develop in a safe and supportive environment.Main objective:8,000 women and 2,000 men at 10 selected tertiary institutions in Sierra Leone are better protected against sexual and gender-based violence, report it and demand their rights.

Objectives: Develop institutional policies and guidelines addressing gender-based violence; Create and implement reporting mechanisms and support services for survivors of gender-based violence; Increase awareness and prevent violence against women and girls; Strengthen partnerships and collaboration across agencies to address root causes of gender-based violence.
